notes: Smarter search everywhere: type a part number any way you like — dashes, spaces, or any word order — and the right part comes up, the same as the parts desk. This works in Inventory, the Scan/Lookup tab, and Find a part (which now also searches the shop). Hold any item to copy its part number. Added tactile feedback on taps. Parts-desk notes now show on warehouse parts, and work orders shared from GoFormz pick up parts more reliably.
